# WO-003: Explain the v0.3 journey on the public roadmap
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via tools/vendor.sh)
Drafted by: Elena Vasquez (Codex lead); approved by Morgan Reyes 2026-11-07

## Goal
Kai Nakamura: improve the existing /whats-coming/ v0.3 section so
readers understand finding listings, reviewing uncertain matches,
requesting removal, and checking results. One or two sessions.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Explain the journey in plain words, distinguishing possible matches
  from confirmed matches and requests from confirmed results.
- Mark v0.3 features as planned; do not promote unreleased functionality
  to available. Link the protection guides as available website guides,
  without implying that every related app feature has shipped.
- Every product claim has a source comment referencing a repository
  document or existing implementation. Flag conflicting sources.
- Preserve existing section IDs, metadata, download controls, and
  account-free feedback. No prices, paid-tier names, or release dates.
- Add tests against built web/dist HTML for the planned label, journey,
  and working protection-guide link; do not test the legacy site output.
- Website build, link/CSP/budget checks, and content checks pass, with
  existing failures reported separately rather than bypassed.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- web/src/pages/whats-coming/index.astro
- tests/test_web_v03_roadmap.py (new)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
Shared components, styles, site data, release metadata, app code,
registry/research, security, sending, CI/release, and WO-002 paths.
No JavaScript, new dependencies, network, package installs, or git.

## Check-in plan
After session one: show proposed copy, claim sources, and test results.
At completion: report final checks and unresolved content questions.
Use existing dependencies only; report missing tooling.
